children: Kelso Technologies reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1.8M, reflecting the industry-wide slowdown in new tank car builds. Operating expenses before foreign exchange and non-cash share-based expense were $954.2K, down 8% year over year; cash used in operations was $805.7K for the first nine months.
Q3 revenue $1.8M; no prior-year figure provided
Revenue reflects the ongoing slowdown in new tank car builds; the release gives no year-over-year revenue comparison.
Lower costs offer some offset to industry weakness, though the measure excludes foreign exchange and non-cash share-based expense.
Cash burn reduced cash by $317.4K; $500K was drawn on the credit line, with $500K still available.
The roughly $1.0M decline narrows the liquidity buffer, despite management's expectation that resources support planned operations.
K2AV approval expected to affect FY2027 revenue
AAR production approval is secured, but revenue depends on commercial deliveries and customer demand.

This is a mid-cycle update amid a cyclical downturn in tank car builds, with cost reductions countering weak demand. Commercial K2AV deliveries and final AAR approval of the Bottom Outlet Valve would be the next catalysts for revenue diversification.
